title: Isolation of extracellular vesicle RNA from serum
protocol: Collect 10 ml of blood in a serum collection tube.
Allow the collected blood to clot at room temperature for 1 hour.
Centrifuge the tube at 3000 rpm for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Aliquot 1 ml of serum into microcentrifuge tubes, being careful not to disturb the interface.
Store the aliquoted samples at -70°C until ready for use.
Transfer 500 µl of serum into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 120 µl Lysis Solution BF to the tube and vortex for 5 seconds, then incubate for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Add 50 µl Protein Precipitation Solution BF to the tube, vortex for 5 seconds, then incubate for 1 minute at room temperature.
Centrifuge the tube at 11,000g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the clear supernatant from step 8 to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Add 675 µl Isopropanol to the transferred supernatant and vortex for 5 seconds.

Assemble a microRNA Mini Spin Column BF in a new collection tube, load 700 µl of sample into the column, and centrifuge at 11,000g for 30 seconds at room temperature. Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Load remaining sample onto the column from step 12 and centrifuge at 11,000g for 30 seconds at room temperature. Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 700 µl Wash Solution 2 BF to the column and centrifuge at 11,000g for 30 seconds at room temperature. Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 250 μl Wash Solution 2 BF to column and centrifuge at 11,000g for 2 min at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 50 μl rDNase directly onto membrane of spin column.
Close lid and incubate for 15 min at room temperature.
Add 100 μl Wash Solution 1 BF to column and centrifuge at 11,000g for 30 sec at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 700 μl Wash Solution 2 BF to column and centrifuge at 11,000g for 30 sec at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 250 μl Wash Solution 2 BF to column and centrifuge at 11,000g for 2 min at room temperature.
Transfer spin column into a new collection tube.
Add 50 μl RNase free H2O directly onto the membrane of spin column.
Close lid and incubate for 1 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 11,000g for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard spin column.
Store purified RNA at -70°C.
Transfer 500 μl of serum into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 700 μl QIAzol Lysis Reagent, vortex 5 sec, incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Add 140 μl chloroform, shake vigorously for 15 sec, incubate for 3 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge sample at 12,000g for 15 min at 4°C.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Add 500 μl 100% Ethanol, mix by pipetting.
Assemble RNAeasy Mini Column in a new collection tube and load the entire sample onto the column.
Centrifuge the sample at 8,000g for 15 seconds at room temperature.
Discard the flow-through and return the column to the collection tube.
Add 700 µl Buffer RPE to the column and centrifuge at 8,000g for 15 seconds at room temperature.
Discard the flow-through and return the column to the collection tube.
Add 500 µl Buffer RPE to the column and centrifuge at 8,000g for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the flow-through and return the column to the collection tube.
Centrifuge the column at 8,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature to dry the membrane.
Transfer the spin column into a new collection tube.
Add 30 µl RNase free H2O directly onto the membrane of the spin column.
Close the lid and centrifuge for 1 minute at 8,000 x g at room temperature.
Discard the spin column and store the purified RNA at -70°C.
Transfer 500 µl of serum into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 100 µl ExoQuick-TC to the sample, mix well, and incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Centrifuge the sample at 13,000 rpm for 2 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and add 350 µl Lysis Buffer to the EV, vortex for 15 seconds, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add 200 µl of 100% Ethanol to the sample and vortex for 10 seconds.
Assemble the Spin Column in a new collection tube and load 700 µl of the sample onto the column.
Centrifuge the sample at 13,000 rpm for 1 minute at room temperature.
Discard the flow-through and return the column to the collection tube.
Load remaining sample onto column and centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 400 µl Wash Buffer to column and centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 400 µl Wash Buffer to column and centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Centrifuge column at 13,000 rpm for 2 min at room temperature to dry membrane.
Transfer spin column into a new collection tube.
Add 30 µl Elution Buffer directly onto the membrane of spin column.
Close lid and centrifuge at 2,000 rpm for 2 min at room temperature.
Increase speed and centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard spin column and store purified RNA at -70°C.
